title: Deno does not call napi finalizers when running test suites
body:
Version: Deno v2.9.0 (observed on v2.7.x, v.2.91)

This problem can be observed clearly with some minor tweaks to the [node-addon-examples](https://github.com/nodejs/node-addon-examples).

```
marcel[12:43:21PM] [~/code/node-addon-examples/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi] git diff -w .
diff --git a/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/index.js b/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/index.js
index bcf2920..93bcdd7 100644
--- a/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/index.js
+++ b/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/index.js
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
+const { test } = require('node:test');
 const addon = require('bindings')('object_template_demo');
 
+test('foo', () => {
   const interceptor = addon.create();
   console.log(interceptor.prop); // 'foo'
   interceptor.prop = 'setting a value';
@@ -8,3 +10,4 @@ delete interceptor.something;
   console.log(interceptor.prop); // 'goober';
   console.log(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(interceptor, "thing")); // true
   console.log(Object.keys(interceptor)[0]); // 'value'
+});
diff --git a/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/object-template-demo.cc b/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/object-template-demo.cc
index 5b04920..d95777a 100644
--- a/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/object-template-demo.cc
+++ b/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/object-template-demo.cc
@@ -134,6 +134,7 @@ napi_value NamedInterceptor::New(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
       proxyTarget,
       obj,
       [](napi_env /*env*/, void* data, void* /*hint*/) {
+        printf("finalizer\n");
         delete reinterpret_cast<NamedInterceptor*>(data);
       },
       nullptr,
diff --git a/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/package.json b/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/package.json
index 6f4da06..76ad684 100644
--- a/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/package.json
+++ b/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi/package.json
@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@
   "version": "0.0.0",
   "description": "Intercept named property access using Proxy",
   "main": "index.js",
+  "type": "commonjs",
   "private": true,
   "gypfile": true,
```

---

I've put a debug log in the finalization callback, wrapped the entry file in `node:test`, and applied the required `package.json` change for CJS.

Here's what I'm observing:
```
marcel[12:41:42PM] [~/code/node-addon-examples/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi] deno --version                                                     
deno 2.9.0 (stable, release, aarch64-apple-darwin)
v8 14.9.207.2-rusty
typescript 6.0.3

marcel[12:41:48PM] [~/code/node-addon-examples/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi] deno test --allow-env --allow-ffi --allow-read --allow-sys index.js
running 1 test from ./index.js
foo ...
------- output -------
foo
setting a value
goober
true
value
----- output end -----
foo ... ok (6ms)

ok | 1 passed | 0 failed (8ms)
```

There is no "finalizer" log. To be sure it is not an artifact of log truncation or something I replaced the log with `std::terminate()` and observed a clean exit code. If you run the example without the `test` wrapper then the finalizer is invoked as expected.

---

nodejs invokes the finalizer as expected:

```
marcel[12:41:50PM] [~/code/node-addon-examples/src/2-js-to-native-conversion/object-template-demo/napi] node  index.js                                                 
foo
setting a value
goober
true
value
✔ foo (0.676875ms)
ℹ tests 1
ℹ suites 0
ℹ pass 1
ℹ fail 0
ℹ cancelled 0
ℹ skipped 0
ℹ todo 0
ℹ duration_ms 3.224708
finalizer
```
